A Weightlifting activity. Install it over 1.0.11; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.12/Spectra.apk)**

### Activities
- **Weightlifting** is now the first choice when you log an activity, before Walking. It uses 3.5 MET, the Compendium of Physical Activities value for a typical weight session (several exercises, 8-15 reps, rest between sets). For example, 60 minutes at 180 lb is about 286 kcal. Strength training stays at 5.0 MET for heavier, faster work like squats and deadlifts.
